item.title: Thai Activist Lawyer Faces Lengthy Prison Sentence Under Lese-Majeste Law
item.description: Thai Activist Lawyer Faces Lengthy Prison Sentence Under Lese-Majeste Law A Thai court has imposed an additional prison sentence on jailed activist lawyer Arnon Nampa, extending his incarceration by two years and eight months for insulting the monarchy. This brings his total sentence to more than 30 years, according to a rights group statement made on Friday.Arnon, aged 41, emerged as a key figure in the 2020 youth-led democracy protests in Bangkok, which boldly demanded reforms in the monarchy.
